**Risk flags:**
- Current ratio 0.96 (below 1) in 2024  
- Non‑clean audit opinion (2023: Disclaimer of opinion)  
- Director 1 holds 51.02 % of shares  

**Overview:**  
Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 7 December 1991, operating private kindergarten and daycare centres in Johor Bahru while registered in Selangor. The firm has two directors, with the leading shareholder—Director 1—owning 51.02 % of the issued share capital of RM 2,500,000. Financially, revenue grew from RM 2,976,052 in 2022 to RM 5,606,840 in 2024, with profit after tax increasing from RM 138,435 to RM 386,389 over the same period.
